title: TransUNet: Rethinking the U-Net architecture design for medical image segmentation through the lens of transformers
mechanism: ViT encoder on CNN features for global context, plus a transformer decoder that refines learnable queries into masks (mask-classification style).
adaptation: R50-ViT hybrid encoder at 512 px (32 x 32 tokens at stride 16), 1-channel stem, PF fine-tune so ImageNet weights survive. The query decoder is the first mask-classification decoder this project would test.
min_experiment: TransUNet encoder + query decoder, PF, 3 seeds, against house PF; metrics test-49 crack IoU, inactive IoU, E1 relF1@2. Kill: no metric above the house by 1 seed SD.
evidence: R: improvements over U-Net and nnU-Net-style baselines on multi-organ and tumour segmentation (abstract level). nnU-Net Revisited found transformer U-Nets below a well-configured CNN in 3D.
prior_overlap: none (BRIEF: no transformer segmenter and no mask-classification decoder tried)
